name: Aksharantar (AI4Bharat), Nepali
licence_source: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ai4bharat/Aksharantar/raw/main/README.md (Licensing Information, read 2026-11-12): "Manually collected data: Released under CC-BY license. Mined dataset (from Samanantar and IndicCorp): Released under CC0 license. Existing sources: Released under CC0 license." Same terms as the Malayalam file (aksharantar.json); the same source filter is applied.
attribution: Aksharantar by AI4Bharat (Madhani et al., 2022), CC BY and CC0. Includes names from Wikidata (CC0).
verdict_reason: The Nepali files have no 'Dakshina Dataset' rows (Dakshina has no Nepali) and no 'Existing sources' rows, so the source filter drops nothing. What is used is mined (IndicCorp: CC0), Wikidata (CC0) or AI4Bharat's manual collection (AK-Freq, AK-Uni, AK-NEI, AK-NEF: CC BY).
used_for: nep_train.json rows (IndicCorp with mining score >= -0.2, Wikidata) as transliterator training pairs for packs/ne.neopack. The manual rows of nep_valid.json (AK-Freq, AK-Uni: 804 pairs) fit the romanised Nepali tables (data/langs/ne/romanisation.json) and validate training. nep_test.json's manual rows (AK-Freq, AK-NEI, AK-NEF, CC BY) are the held-out eval set: its words are left out of every training pair.
notes: Fetched 2026-11-12. Extract with: unzip nep.zip -d data/raw/aksharantar-nep/extracted (data/build-ne-text.sh does). nep_train.json has 2,397,414 rows: IndicCorp 2,391,227, AK-Freq 3,539, Wikidata 2,648. nep_valid.json 2,804: IndicCorp 1,989, AK-Freq 525, AK-Uni 279, Wikidata 11. nep_test.json 4,101: AK-Freq 2,108, AK-NEI 1,176, AK-NEF 817. The CC0 statement says 'We do not own any of the text from which this data has been extracted': mined pairs are single words, which we treat as unprotectable on their own.
status: in packs/ne.neopack, a file handed out for a trial, not offered for download, not in the app
